workshoptitle: Migrate CentOS Stream 9 to Oracle Linux 9 on OCI

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the migration journey, prerequisites, and success criteria.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Connect to Your CentOS Stream Source
tutorials.description: Connect to the instructor-prepared CentOS Stream 9 VM and check its readiness.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Baseline CentOS Stream
tutorials.description: Deploy Apache on the assigned VM and save a baseline.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Assess Readiness and Protect the Source
tutorials.description: Verify the migration script, run a dry run, and back up the boot volume.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Migrate to Oracle Linux
tutorials.description: Convert the same VM to the latest Oracle Linux 9 release and reboot into RHCK.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Manage and Patch Oracle Linux
tutorials.description: Review repositories, update packages, and verify the workload.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Apply Live Updates with Oracle Ksplice
tutorials.description: Install Ksplice and verify live RHCK updates without rebooting.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Validate and Hand Off
tutorials.description: Compare migration evidence and hand the VM back to the instructor.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common solutions and assistance options.
